items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Then Bert... I can't think of this guy's name. He was a trumpet player, and he owned the Band Box.

ctx.x: John Simmen. He was there. First time I met him. They had brought him in there (I was making a rehearsal) for somebody, to make some record. That was the Band Box...no, not the Band Box, the Amsterdam Club. Then Bert... I can't think of this guy's name. He was a trumpet player, and he owned the Band Box. He was a West Indian. And he got smart. He went up and got up on an electric light post, and hooked up some gimmick on there for stealing electricity from Edison, and lit up his place, had it all lit up, you…
